   Supplier booleanValue = builder.define( "booleanValue", true );

   Supplier integerValue = builder.define( "integerValue", 5, 0, 10 );

This mod explicitly requires an nvidia gpu that supports mesh shaders. 
This feature was introduced in turing architecture, anything that is a 16xx series or newer (20xx series also works) that supports mesh shaders.

 Extreme sound muffler is a client side mod that allows you to muffle sounds selectively. 
 
 Now with Dark mode!! check the configs to enable it! 

 This Mod works on FORGE and FABRIC . 

 HOW IT WORKS:

 1. Click on the button in your inventory or assign a key to open the gui.

 2. Click on the button next to the sound you want to muffle.

 3. Optional: set the volume of the sound dragging the slider around.

 4. Optional: press the play button to be sure that's the sound you want to muffle.

 5. Enjoy peace.

 What about Anchors?
 Anchors are ranged mufflers, for when you want to muffle a sound on a small area.

 1. Open your ESM Screen

 2. Select one of the 10 numbered buttons

 3. Press the marker like button on the right panel to set the Anchor position

 4. Optional: press the edit Anchor button (next to marker) and set the name and range of the Anchor

Pathly

Pathly is a light-weight Fabric Minecraft mod that makes
creating path blocks smoother and more intuitive.

Paths can be created by directly targeting e.g. dirt blocks or by
targeting "replaceable" blocks on top of them.

This makes path-making feel much more natural. No more needing to clear vegetation before using a shovel!

In addition, sword and axe items will avoid hitting foliage.

 Features

- Automatically shifts the shovel’s path-creation check downward when the aimed block is replaceable.
- Fully vanilla-friendly behavior which doesn't change the properties of any block.
- Works with any Shovel Item

 PvP preferences : Choose whether to disable or enable PvP for yourself
 Colored name tags : Uses vanilla's teams to display players' PvP states
 Combat flagging : While flagged, toggling is disabled, and disconnecting for any reason while it's active will result in being killed
 Global PvP : Force PvP on or off for all players server-wide; this takes priority over everything else
 Pet protect : Protect all tamed mobs from players whose PvP is off (the pet owner’s PvP state is not factored in)
 Forced PvP in other dimensions : You can force PvP in specific dimensions
 LuckPerms support : Allows you to customize accessibility to things

autoattributeswap:
Auto-Attribute-Swap (AAS)

Tired of having to perfectly time pressing your hotbar slot and attack button at the same time? This mod automates attribute swapping for you!

 Check out my video!
 

 What is attribute swapping?
Attribute swapping is a movement technique where switching hotbar slots and attacking in the same game tick causes the server to blend attributes from both items. With a lunge spear, this gives you a massive speed boost. Works on multiplayer servers — server-side install needed.

 Features
- Automatically swaps hotbar slots on every attack press
- Works with lunge spears, maces, and any other weapon
- Toggle on/off with a hotkey (configurable in controls menu, default is G ) at any time (shows ON/OFF overlay)
- Configure your primary and secondary slots via Mod Menu → Attribute Swap → Config
- Client-side + Server side for moderation

 Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2 /

At first, SCP-427 seems like a powerful artifact. Carrying it open in the inventory grants regeneration, cures harmful effects, and over time enhances the player with night vision, saturation, strength and more.

This mod allows mod packs and servers to restrict access to dimensions based on a player's progression in the world. This is done by hooking into Game Stages , a framework for developing custom progression systems. To learn more please read the Game Stages wiki and the Dimension Stages documentation . 

 Example Usage 
 Imagine that you want to restrict access to the nether until players have completed an objective such as crafting a certain item or defeating a boss. This would be done by staging the nether dimension to a stage such as "nether access". You can then use a script to detect when players have completed that objective and grant them that stage. This will prevent players from accessing the dimension until they have completed your objective and triggered the "nether access" stage to be unlocked.

The mechanic is handled server-side, making it suitable for multiplayer servers where all players share the same behavior without needing to install the mod themselves.

accuratehitboxes:
Accurate Hitboxes

Accurate Hitboxes replaces Minecraft's broad entity hit detection with hitboxes derived from visible model parts. Attacks and projectiles must intersect the model geometry instead of only the vanilla bounding box.

 Features

- Per-part hitboxes for vanilla and many modded entities
- Animated hitboxes that follow model movement, rotation, scaling, and entity state
- Dedicated-server synchronization for model-derived hitboxes
- GeckoLib 4 support when GeckoLib is installed
- Blacklist and whitelist configuration modes
- Configurable per-part debug outlines with F3+B 
- TaCZ bullet compatibility on Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1
- Baby and scaled-entity support

 Requirements

Accurate Hitboxes must be installed on both the client and server, and both sides must use the same release.

The current mod release supports Minecraft 1.20.1 :

- Fabric and Quilt
- Forge and NeoForge

SafeLogin is to ensure that the player cannot be harmed when they are logging in.

Nametag Ping

A lightweight Fabric client mod that appends live ping (Xms) to every player's nametag, with color-coded thresholds and full support for Standard & TextDisplay-based nametags .

Unlike other ping mods, this works reliably on servers with custom nametag plugins, making it compatible with servers like mcpvp.club and stray.gg .

 Features: 
- Supports both standard and TextDisplay nametags
- Configurable colors and ping thresholds
- Configurable format for ping display
- Toggleable display
- Compatible with Tier Tagger & Tiers!

 Configurable through Mod Menu 

---

 Requirements / Installation

1. Install the Fabric Loader 
 - Download from the Fabric website 
 - Run the installer and select your Minecraft version 

2. Install dependencies 
 - Fabric API 
 - Cloth Config API

totemoptimizer:
The Problem

By default, Minecraft waits for multiple server packets before applying totem effects and playing the animation. On low ping this is barely noticeable, but on high ping servers (100ms+) this causes a visible delay between taking lethal damage and seeing the totem pop — your screen can freeze or flash while waiting.

 The Fix

TotemOptimizer intercepts the totem activation packet the moment it arrives and immediately applies all effects client-side:

- Health restored to 1 instantly
- Negative effects cleared immediately
- Regeneration, Absorption, and Fire Resistance applied right away
- Totem animation plays without delay
 
The server still handles all the actual game logic — this mod only makes the client respond faster to what the server already decided. 

 Who is this for?

- Crystal PvP players on high ping servers
- Anyone who plays on servers far from their region

Tread Lightly gives every block its own footsteps. Vanilla picks one sound per block and plays it at a fixed rate, while Tread Lightly works out what is under each foot in turn and plays what fits the way you are moving over it. Mobs and other players get the same treatment, and horses, cows and other four-legged mobs step in uneven pairs.

A few sounds go on top of the step. Puddles and rain add a splash, long grass brushes your legs when you sprint or go barefoot and chains jingle as you pass them.

It replaces the sounds, not the game. Nothing is added, nothing is craftable, no block or entity behaves differently and no world data changes.

 Sound packs

What a block sounds like comes from a resource pack, not from the mod. Block maps, acoustics and audio are read through the ordinary resource pack system, so packs stack, reload with F3+T and override each other in the order you set.

Sable Scoped Links adds Sable-aware scoping to Create redstone links.

By default, Create redstone links can communicate globally within their normal range rules, which can cause links inside Sable sub-levels to interact with links in the ordinary world or in other sub-levels. This mod changes that behavior so redstone links can be limited by their Sable sub-level context.

 Features

- Prevents Create redstone links inside one Sable sub-level from leaking into another.
- Supports configurable scoping behavior:
 - Vanilla Create behavior
 - Same sub-level only
 - Sub-level and ordinary world bridging
- Supports Ordinary links, Mobile linked controllers, and typewriters.

 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- Create
- Sable

ariadnes-thread:
Inspired by AtomicStryker's Magic Yarn mod, named after the myth of the labyrinth and Minotaur, Ariadne's Thread adds an item that lets you see where you've been.

Once you've crafted the Thread, simply right-click it to get it to start working. Every 20 ticks, it'll save your position (if you're far away enough from your previous) and draw a line connecting them. This line is visible through blocks, and changes color to show the start and end of your travel.

 

This is mainly intended to help you find your way back out of sprawling cave systems, though it also works for any similar use-cases.

Pretty much everything in the mod is configurable, as well! You can change the start and end colors, the check interval, the minimum distance between points, etc. You can also set the max amount of locations to save, for performance reasons.

A client-side fabric mod hiding player names if they are not in sight, or if they are too far.

A sneaky player names.properties config file will be automatically generated in the mod config directory.

intuitive-netherite:
The Problem
After update 1.20, Mojang changed how getting netherite equipment worked. Originally you only needed to get 4 pieces of scrap, 4 gold ingots, and then slap it into a smithing table. 1.20 introduced the smithing templates and overhauled the smithing table, and as a result added the netherite smithing template, but this change still feels to simple, to easy, and not intuitive. Instead, I would rather focus on the logistical issues with the netherite process, specifically, smelting. For an unburnable item, why can it be smelted normally?? The item, that can survive being thrown into lava, cannot last 2 seconds in a furnace powered by coal. Ridiculous.

 How to use it

Get a configured rod with:

/occ get charged=true
 

For example:

/occ get 72 32 charged=true

/occ get 48 24 charged=false

Universal Compression
Compress (nearly) any block in the game into progressively denser stacks, up to nine tiers deep .

- No upfront configuration required. Every block from every installed mod is supported automatically at startup.
- Nine blocks of any type craft into one compressed block. That block is itself compressible. Repeat up to nine times. The math gets silly fast, and that is the point.

- Loot and recipe tables are generated virtually at runtime, meaning there are no datapack files bloating your instance for every possible block combination.

Sulfur Cube: Combinations expands Sulfur Cubes with a new combination system. Instead of being limited to one absorbed block, a Sulfur Cube can now hold two different blocks at once, creating new mixed properties and special interactions.

 Interactions
Players can place, replace and remove each side of the Sulfur Cube separately. This makes combinations easy to control. Duplicate blocks are ignored, so the same block cannot be used twice to stack the same effect.
 Same Attributes
Combining blocks with the same attribute (like Oak Planks with Spruce Planks) creates a stronger version of that attribute.
 Different Attributes
Different attributes (like Stone with Wood) are blended into one shared result.
 Shared Abilities
Special abilities from both blocks (like TNT, Magma Block, ...) can work together.

 Progression

- Encourages seeking out multiple villages to access different distance ranges

Predator Pursuit

This lightweight datapack introduces a predator behavior system to hostile mobs in Minecraft. When a hostile mob (zombie, skeleton, spider, etc.) kills a passive animal (sheep, cow, chicken, pig), that mob receives a Speed I effect for 8 seconds and becomes more likely to target other nearby passive mobs.

 How It Works

The system detects when passive mobs die near hostile entities and applies the speed boost to the killer. During the 8-second window, the affected hostile mob will prioritize chasing other animals in range before returning to normal behavior. This can result in situations where a zombie tears through a field of sheep or a spider hunts chickens.

 Technical Details

- Entirely passive operation with no player intervention required
- No commands or permissions available to players

NoCombatSound is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack that removes all major combat-related sound effects.

No textures or gameplay elements are changed — only sound effects.

 Features

- Fire sounds removed
 (burning, fire crackle, ambient fire)
 
- Explosion sounds removed
 (TNT, crystal, Anchor)
 
- Ender pearl sounds removed
 (throw + teleport impact)
 
- Hit sounds removed
 (when attacking players or mobs)
 
- Damage/hurt sounds removed
 (when the player takes any type of damage)
 
- Fully client-side
 
- Zero performance impact
 
- Clean, minimal, and PvP-friendly

 Compatibility

- This resource pack works on:
 
- All modern Minecraft versions that support resource packs
 
- Vanilla
 
- Fabric / Quil

The Toyo Rapid 2000 series was directly based on the 05N series' design and is almost identical throughout. Operated by the Toyo Rapid Railway, an extension of the Tozai Line with through services, it entered service between 2004 and 2006.

This pack adds both trains to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod.

Each train has four types of cars, which may be configured as desired.
- Cab forwards
- Trailer
- Pantograph trailer
- Cab backwards

Lode Claims
A Spigot plugin that allows you and your players to claim regions, simply by placing a lodestone block

 Requirements
- Java 16 or newer
- Spigot (or Paper/Purpur/...) for Minecraft 1.17 or newer
- WorldGuard 7.0.7 or newer

 Usage
Simply install and configure the Plugin. That's it. No Database or complicated setup required.
The Owner of a region can right click the lodestone and then rightclick a player in order to add them to the region.
To unclaim an area, the owner has to mine the lodestone, and then mine it again, to confirm the unclaim.

Hop on over to GitHub to suggest things or get a bug fixed

🏦 Island Bank — Shared Team Finances

Adds a shared bank account to each island. Team members can deposit and withdraw money, making it easy to pool resources for upgrades, challenges, and purchases.

 Features

- Shared balance — all team members access the same island bank
- Deposit & withdraw — simple commands and an in-game GUI
- Interest — configurable interest rate, compounded on a schedule
- Statements — see who deposited and withdrew, and when
- Rich list — rank islands by balance, with placeholders for scoreboards
- Admin tools — check, give, take or set any island's balance
- Works with Vault-compatible economy plugins 
- Works with all BentoBox game modes
